name: Damascus Leg
identity_notes: Named for Damascus Township. Henry County only. Eastern terminus at SR 109 near Damascus Township.

name: Independence Leg
identity_notes: Named segment of the MW&E Canal Towpath. Straddles Defiance/Henry county line. Western terminus at Independence Dam SP (ODNR state park, already staged in DEF run).

name: Napoleon Leg
identity_notes: Runs through Napoleon. Western terminus at Meyerholtz Park (Napoleon city park — T6 entity). Eastern terminus at Henry County Hospital.

name: Renegade Leg
identity_notes: Named for Simon Girty (historical figure). Henry County only. Eastern terminus at Napoleon.

name: WideWater Section
identity_notes: Named WideWater (historic canal engineering term for widened canal section). Eastern terminus at Providence Dam Metropark (Wood County / Metroparks Toledo entity). Multi-county (Henry + Wood).
